cs1.title: CS-1
cs1.description: A CS-80-style polysynth: two layers, its tone bars, effects and user presets, with velocity and aftertouch from the keys.
cs1.alt: CS-1's screen: its tone bars and the preset BLADE BRASS

scintilla.title: Scintilla
scintilla.description: The 1981 Elka Synthex with all 80 factory patches, the laser harp among them, checked sample by sample against its browser original.
scintilla.alt: Scintilla's screen: the patch RING MOD., the laser harp

obervave.title: OberVave
obervave.description: A four-track analog-style poly with arpeggiator, sequencer and effects; its pages, presets and patterns live in fm1-dock's banks.
obervave.alt: OberVave's PERFORM page: cutoff, resonance, envelope, release

fm1-sid.source: joakimeriksson/fm1-sid 3210dc1 (FM-1 SID 0.3's code), dock/build.sh with fm1-dock 3cd4e55
fm1-sid.songs: GoatTracker 2's example songs: Dojo, Unleash, Sanction, Consultant, Transylvanian, Hyperspace, Sixpack, Everlasting
fm1-sid.title: FM-1 SID
fm1-sid.description: C64 music: a cycle-exact 6510 and reSID, GoatTracker 2 songs with their editor on the knobs, and any .sid from its page plays at once.
fm1-sid.alt: FM-1 SID's screen: Arkanoid by Martin Galway, three voices, the filter, the scope

amb.source: modules/amb: charlesvestal/fm1-amb 7797f4e (AMB-1 1.3 and one commit), fm1-dock 2037c7b
amb.title: AMB-1
amb.description: A generative ambient machine after Music for Airports: pads, bells on tape loops and a gliding bass play themselves while you tend them.
amb.alt: AMB-1's screen: the Garden, D Dorian on Dm7, the four layers' levels

fomni.source: modules/fomni: charlesvestal/fm1-fomni 7e7547f (FoMni-1 0.4 and four commits), fm1-dock 2037c7b
fomni.title: FoMni
fomni.description: A chord harp after the Omnichord: chords on the black keys, strummed on the white ones, with a bass and a rhythm box.
fomni.alt: FoMni's screen: the chord C, the strings and the chord buttons

fm106.source: modules/fm106: PatttF/fm-106 db59d58 (FM-106 Beta 6 and one commit; modules/fm106/take.py), fm1-dock f3fdddb
fm106.title: FM-106
fm106.description: The Roland Juno-106: six voices, the 128 factory presets, its BBD chorus, arpeggiator and sequencer; three voices run on the chip's second core.
fm106.alt: FM-106's screen: the preset A85 Rocket Men, three voices playing, the VCF's sliders and the oscilloscope

monk.source: modules/monk: charlesvestal/fm1-monk a9d368a (MONK-1 0.9.1 and four commits; modules/monk/take.py), fm1-dock 5c44a92
monk.title: MONK-1
monk.description: Twelve singers on MonkSynth's formant voice, each on its own stage: the mouth follows the vowel, and the keys give velocity and pressure.
monk.alt: MONK-1's screen: Jerry the monk singing with his mouth wide open, Vowel, Head, Breath and Glide below

fimba.title: FiMba-1
fimba.description: A kalimba by modal synthesis: tines on the white keys, thumb-roll chords on the black, with its body, buzzers, a sound hole's wah, delay and reverb.
fimba.alt: FiMba-1's screen: three tines ringing in C major, the chord keys, Material Steel, Hardness, Decay and Tone

gator.title: GATOR
gator.description: A macro-oscillator on Emilie Gillet's Plaits DSP: 24 models in 3 banks, a low-pass gate, two LFOs and an 8-slot modulation matrix.
gator.alt: GATOR's screen: the model WAVETABLE, its harmonics, timbre and morph, the wave under them

dub.source: modules/dub: sbegueria/fm1-dub 501c4cf (DUB-1 1.4.3 and five commits; modules/dub/take.py), fm1-dock 9d3aac5
dub.title: DUB-1
dub.voices: 4 chord voices, 6 pings, a bass, 5 drums
dub.description: A generative dub techno machine, AMB-1's fork: chord stabs dissolve in a tape echo over a steady kick, in eight pieces it plays by itself.
dub.alt: DUB-1's screen: the Form page, the chord Fm7 in its ripples, the lanes of the phrase, Energy, Vary, Motion and Drift

sine.title: SINE
sine.description: Dinghy's sine, always there: the fallback when a module fails, and the smallest module to copy when you write your own.
sine.alt: SINE's screen: a sine to build on, the note C4
